map.输入射精后离心尿液中的精子计数与精液量，工具评估逆行射精的程度（轻/中/重），并: Enter the sperm count in centrifuged post-ejaculation urine and the semen volume, and the tool grades the degree of retrograde ejaculation (mild/moderate/severe) and compares it with the normal semen volume to judge whether a large share of sperm has flowed back into the bladder, for andrology follow-up and diagnosis.
map.射精后尿液精子占比。: The proportion of sperm in the urine after ejaculation.

map.：尿液 20% → 部分逆行，前向精液仍可自然受孕，必要时回收尿精子。: Urine at 20% → partial retrograde ejaculation; forward ejaculation can still allow natural conception, and recovering sperm from urine is an option if needed.
